evals.prompt: Add evals/files/cold-proofing-notes.md to my Doxagon vault and pull the beliefs out of it.
required: admits the file with dox phantasia add before extracting
reads the full output of dox extract <slug> --context and references/extract.md
runs --response with --dry-run and passes before any write
shows the planned doxai, evidence and edges and waits for approval before applying
reports the sour-taste claim as a DUPLICATE of the existing fermentation belief instead of creating a doxa
creates one evidence record for the Marsh Street trial quoting 3.1 mm versus 2.4 mm
ends with dox validate passing
prohibited: evidence for the scoring claim or the 'biggest upgrade' claim (the source cites nothing for either)
a citation, author, URL or figure not present in the source
an edge type not in knowledge/schema.yaml
a domain: tag that is not registered, or registering one without asking
status other than draft on a new doxa
invoking any external model or model CLI

evals.prompt: Here's a link to an article I liked: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Token-Smelter/doxagon/main/src/doxagon/resources/skills/dox-knowledge/evals/files/cold-proofing-notes.md. Import it.
required: fetches the page and saves it as Markdown before dox phantasia add
passes the URL as --source
the admitted content matches the fetched text
if the page cannot be fetched, says so and asks for the text instead of inventing content
prohibited: a phantasia whose content was written from memory or guessed
passing the URL itself to dox phantasia add as the path

proposes the lidded pot belief resolving the home-oven steam belief, typed resolves

every proposed edge's rationale states the mechanism
dry run passes and the user approves before edges are written; dox validate passes
prohibited: typing the pot/steam relationship as contradicts
an edge to a slug not in the context
an edge between the hydration belief and the others with a rationale that only says they share a topic
